mapper.update: UPDATE yy_schedule SET available_num = available_num - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND available_num > 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO yy_schedule (id, doc_id, work_date, available_num, status) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.docId}, #{item.workDate}, #{item.availableNum}, #{item.status})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS scheduleId, s.work_date AS workDate, s.available_num AS availableNum, s.status AS scheduleStatus, d.id AS docId, d.name AS docName, d.title AS docTitle, d.fee AS docFee, d.dept_id AS deptId FROM yy_schedule s JOIN yy_doctor d ON d.id = s.doc_id WHERE s.work_date = #{workDate} ORDER BY d.dept_id, d.id
